author: Nebbsy
body:
Hello I was recently false banned, AbusiveUsers apparently has a video of me hitting someone behind my back which is %100 false. All though it may appear in the video i had hit someone behind my back, lag is actually my legit excuse/reason. while i was playing my game would keep freezing but i was allowed to move, while its frozen i would go around hitting players. when it un freezes and goes back to real in game time it all speeds up and I could have hit someone who was behind me but i would have turned around and hit someone else who was infront of me making it appear as if i was smacking someone behind me. I was not however recording as I play because it causes me more lag. my main account (AuraClient) is not banned but Manaiphy is, (Manaiphy is the acc that was banned) i have spent too much time and money on this server to "Hack". please un ban manaiphy so i can continue playing on my favorite server of all time. A lot of people know me as well including staff members, that doesnt really help my case but whats the point of me hacking?? so i can lose $150 to a server that ill never play again! 

Sincerely, Neb

replies.author: AbusiveUser
replies.body:
When I was watching in you in the game, I noticied a strange movement in your head in the minute 0:07.
Clearly it was noted when you killed the player you had lag but when you are having lag issues you don't hit like you did, so that does not explain the weird movements in your head.

When someone have lag, you don't hit when you are not looking at him. You were clearly using a client and the evidence prove it.
You only need common sense to understand you were hacking in that match.

Evidence:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZEJeBwqh2ig

Sincerely, Abusive.
